preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 10**6 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each number ai written on the vertices must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

preconditions.expression: len(edges) == n - 1 and all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n and x != y for x, y in edges)
preconditions.description: There must be exactly n-1 edges, and each edge must connect two distinct vertices within the range of 1 to n.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(sum(I(x, y) for x in range(1, n + 1) for y in range(x + 1, n + 1)))
postconditions.description: The output must be the sum of the differences between the maximum and minimum values on all simple paths connecting vertices x and y.
